observation.command: grep -oE "WFS_Capabilities|<Service>|<Title>[^<]*</Title>" /tmp/wfs40.xml | head -6; echo "=== SynWFS ==="; timeout 40 curl -s -o /tmp/syn.xml -w "HTTP %{http_code}, bytes %{size_download}\n" "http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wfs-syn/services/xplansynwfs?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities&version=2.0.0"; echo "=== WFS 5.0 / 5.1 / 5.2 / 6.0 ==="; for v in wfs50 wfs51 wfs52 wfs60; do printf "%s: " $v; timeout 40 curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}, bytes %{size_download}\n" "http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wfs/services/$v?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities"; done
